units.spine: The road is open, the market keeps its day, and nothing here is being built or sold off.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: Most of what the town earns comes off one trade. The other sources of income do not come near it.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: The stalls carry goods made here beside goods brought in, and nothing marks which is which for a stranger.
No two loads in the yards are the same, and every one of them is bound out.
The town eats, and the matter comes up only when a stranger asks.
The Cartographer's guild in Hochhausen keeps its building and its craft, and the supply it works from has failed upstream.
